Name: Gorold Goodbrother
Quirks: speaks with Iron Islands bluntness - no prettiness no ceremony beyond what custom demands
the Old Way and Drowned God are natural reference points
is calculating beneath the bluntness - twelve daughters means twelve political tools if managed correctly
CharacterDescription: Gorold Goodbrother is the Lord of Hammerhorn on Great Wyk and head of House Goodbrother - one of the more significant houses of the Iron Islands though still subordinate to Greyjoy. He has twelve daughters and a son, Greydon, who will inherit. He governs Hammerhorn with the blunt Iron Islands approach: strength first, tradition always. He follows the Old Way and the Drowned God with the sincere conviction of a man for whom these things are not ideology but lived reality. He watches Balon Greyjoy's ambitions with the calculating loyalty of a man who will ride the tide if it goes the right way.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Gorold Goodbrother is the Lord of Hammerhorn and the head of House Goodbrother.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Hammerhorn two days before Ned Stark's execution. Watching the mainland wars with Iron Islands interest.
